sloka: ताभिः परिवृतो राजा सुरूपाभिर्महायशाः ।तस्मृगद्विजसम्घष्टं प्रविष्टः प्रमदावनम् ।। ५-१८-२७।।
transliteration: tābhiḥ parivṛto rājā surūpābhirmahāyaśāḥ ।tasmṛgadvijasamghaṣṭaṁ praviṣṭaḥ pramadāvanam ।। 5-18-27।।

translations.english: Surrounded by beauties, the glorious king entered the grove meant for women, reverberating with the sounds of beasts and birds.
